recommendation: Merge. AUTO DETECT is now a real, honest route on guided captures: declared-null flows through D's registry-terminated ladder with the ported stroke-heuristic-1, family-level outcomes and abstentions are durable records that release the permit and render truthful copy, and declarations still narrow-never-force with disagreements surfaced instead of resolved. Follow-ups for the next wave: (1) dedup — swing-lab should delete its strokeHeuristic.ts body and re-export from @pickle/vision-geometry (both copies byte-equivalent in behavior today; W4 deliberately left swing-lab untouched), and its labProviders can pass the same adapter to exercise AUTO on the desktop lab; (2) expect a high predicted_family/abstained rate on real mobile captures (no paddle track or speed series → wrist-at-contact fallback) — the 'analyzed' surface presents family reads as reads, not failures, but product should watch the rate; (3) if leaf-level auto detection is wanted beyond OVERHEAD, the blocker remains bounce observation — do NOT relax AUTO_RESOLUTION_MIN_CONFIDENCE or promote depth-2; (4) imported-video AUTO stays unavailable until import-time pose extraction ships — the picker on that path still requires a concrete technique by design.
risks: Heuristic confidences are uncalibrated (documented in strokeAutoResolution.ts and the manifest entry); AUTO precision equals the heuristic's structural margins. User-facing copy deliberately claims only family-level ability.
On-device runs have paddle:null and no speed series, so OVERHEAD is the only reachable predicted_l3 leaf today; everything else is family or abstention. UI copy is written for that reality.

Declared runs now also execute the hierarchical classifier (disagreement surfacing). A committed contradictory side (≥0.525 + margin) inserts the new 'analyzed' interstitial before the Result screen on a previously direct path — intended honesty behavior, but it is a UX change reviewers should sign off on; clean declared runs are bit-identical in flow.

strokeIntentPresentation tests in analyzeScreenAutoDetect.test.tsx use narrow cast fixtures for the leaf/disagreement branches (real-record coverage exists for family/abstained/declared-clean in autoDetectAnalysis.test.ts); if the presenter starts reading more record fields, extend the casts.
